summary: In ansible-core 2.11, apt_key makes file mutually exclusive with data, keyserver and url, and meta tasks now respect tags, so tag them always to keep the old behaviour.
questions: apt_key fails saying file and url are mutually exclusive, why?
My meta: flush_handlers is skipped when I use --tags, how do I fix it?

answer_card.title: apt_key exclusivity and tagged meta tasks
answer_card.answer_md:
- `apt_key`: `file` can't be combined with `data`, `keyserver` or `url`.
- `meta` tasks now **honour tags**. To keep them always running:

```yaml
- meta: flush_handlers
  tags: always
```
